name: AUR Helper & Package Engine
shortDesc: Tool to automatically resolve dependencies and compile packages from Arch User Repository.
detailedDesc: Essential for ricing utilities, proprietary apps, and bleeding-edge GitHub releases.

phase.title: Base & Architecture
phase.description: Core display server protocols, desktop architecture paradigms, and package manager helpers.

packages.name: Paru (Recommended)
packages.description: Feature-rich, high-performance Pacman/AUR wrapper written in Rust with interactive review diffs.
pros: Built-in PKGBUILD diff viewer before building
cons: Requires Rust toolchain during initial bootstrap compile

packages.name: Yay (Yet Another Yogurt)
packages.description: The most famous and widely adopted AUR helper for Arch Linux, written in Go.
cons: Doesn't force-prompt PKGBUILD reviews by default
